title: Add interactive RAG developer shell and lightweight webhook adapter samples
author: Sofia Patel
description: Motivation: provide a compact, reproducible developer onboarding path for teams building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) features that need both an interactive iteration surface and a minimal webhook adapter for tool-calling integration. This PR adds a small interactive shell (node + ts) that runs a live RAG session against a local dev index and a lightweight express-based webhook adapter that demonstrates tool invocation patterns and telemetry hooks. Checklist: - [x] interactive shell prototype with replayable session recording - [x] webhook adapter with auth stub and structured tool-call contract - [x] example prompts and sample index (small synthetic corpus) - [x] docs site quickstart page and end-to-end walkthrough - [x] CI smoke tests and playground e2e smoke script Changes summary: adds a new quickstart under examples/rag-dev-shell and a webhook adapter under examples/rag-webhook-adapter, updates docs/quickstarts to include a walkthrough and adds a small set of telemetry probes in examples/common/telemetry. The interactive shell supports stepwise replay, streaming mock responses for token-by-token debugging and a --seeded mode for deterministic evals. The webhook adapter implements a minimal tool contract with JSON schema and includes a simulated external connector for calendar lookup and HTTP fetch tools. Commits: - Add initial rag-dev-shell prototype with TS CLI, replay recorder and example corpus - Wire up rag-webhook-adapter express scaffold, tool contract and auth stub - Docs: add quickstart guide, architecture diagram and troubleshooting notes - Tests: add smoke e2e script and CI pipeline job description Files changed (high level): - examples/rag-dev-shell/cli.ts - examples/rag-dev-shell/README.md - examples/rag-dev-shell/sample-index/*.json - examples/rag-webhook-adapter/server.js - examples/rag-webhook-adapter/tool-contracts/schema.json - examples/common/telemetry/probes.ts - docs/quickstarts/rag-dev-shell.md - .github/workflows/rag-dev-shell-smoke.yml CI notes: a new CI job (rag-dev-shell-smoke) was added to run the shell in a headless mode and exercise the webhook adapter; initial run surfaced a flaky network stub causing one rerun, resolved by adding a deterministic mock and a 2s backoff in the adapter. Performance/regressions: this PR is intentionally lightweight and avoids changes to the serving runtime; there are no model weight or infra changes. Backwards compatibility: webhook adapter follows the published tool contract v1 and is opt-in; nothing in the PR alters existing quickstarts. Related work: references ENG-8273 (Developer onboarding quickstarts), and a previous experiment PR (pr-271891) for a similar micro-orc approach. Release notes: Adds a new interactive RAG quickstart and a webhook adapter example to improve developer onboarding and enable quick experimentation with tool-calling patterns. Merge: squash and merge performed after approvals and CI green.
